behaviour: cultivation of cuticular Pseudonocardia that suppresses Escovopsis

direction_semantics.accept: An attine association with, maintenance of, or cultivation of cuticular Pseudonocardia is directly reported.
direction_semantics.reject: A controlled comparison directly reports absence or removal of the association.
direction_semantics.unknown: Association is inferred from omission or is not directly observed.

chemical_target_class: microbial antifungal compounds produced by ant-associated actinomycetes
expected_outcome: The default extractor recovers explicit organism-compound-activity statements, including dentigerumycin, from the positive-control papers.
europe_pmc_query: TITLE_ABS:(attine OR fungus-growing ant) AND TITLE_ABS:(Pseudonocardia OR actinomycete OR Escovopsis) AND (antifungal OR antibiotic OR symbiosis) AND OPEN_ACCESS:Y

reference_sources.citation: Oh et al. 2009 Nature Chemical Biology
